pages.text: Crickets are the primary frog resource. Live crickets are recognized as prey. Cricket items are how you interact with tamed frogs: the first one tames them, and each one after that harvests $(l:zen_amphibia:resources/frog_slime)Frog Slime$(/l) and puts the frog in love mode for $(l:zen_amphibia:genetics/breeding_goals)breeding$(/l).
One item, three uses: taming, slime farming, and breeding. Feed two tamed adult frogs and they will seek each other out. A steady cricket supply is the foundation of any serious frog project.
